answer: Each agent locks 25 POA for twelve epochs and must finish five distinct jobs, each audited by three randomly drawn reviewers who share no funder and no earlier review overlap. Two matching approvals pass a job; proven collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger stays readable: a dawn of first-time identities earns no privileges until tenure accumulates, an orchard of independent work histories proves real participation, and a signal of reused evidence flags copies. Each extra sybil needs its own bond, jobs, and reviewers, so farming costs more than it yields.
